infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: El-Biblio uses the camera to let you record Face2Face reflections and capture media to share with the community.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: El-Biblio uses the microphone to capture audio while recording Face2Face reflections.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: El-Biblio saves videos/photos to your library when you choose to export Face2Face reflections.

plugins.iosMicrophonePermission: Allow El-Biblio to use the microphone so you can speak in live sessions.
plugins.iosBluetoothPermission: Allow El-Biblio to use Bluetooth for improved audio during live sessions.
plugins.androidMicrophonePermission: Allow El-Biblio to record audio during live sessions.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you share them with your friends.
